heading: EXT. DRAINED BACKYARD POOL - SKATE SPOT - DUSK

units.text: EXT. DRAINED BACKYARD POOL - SKATE SPOT - DUSK
A kidney-shaped pool, empty, graffitied in swirling teal and orange.
Weeds in the cracks.
A string of fairy lights sags between two fence posts.
JUNIPER OKAFOR-LEE (16, hoodie, bleached tips) stands on the lip with her board tucked under her arm.
DEVONTE PRYCE (17, long limbs, headphones around his neck) sits on the coping, pumping a flat tire.
MIREILLE SANTOS (15, jean jacket covered in patches) films with a phone.
KASPER LUND (16, bruised elbows, grin) balances on the diving board of an old above-ground slide.
ANSELMA TREVINO (17, quiet, helmet always buckled) sits cross-legged at the shallow end, taping her knuckles.
Who's going first?
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: Who's going first?
units.name: DEVONTE

units.text: ^I asked.
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: ^I asked.
units.name: DEVONTE

units.text: Not it.
units.name: KASPER

units.text: You can't say not it. You're already on the board.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: I am a free spirit.
units.name: KASPER

units.text: You are a hospital waiting to happen.
units.name: ANSELMA

units.text: Kasper leaps off the slide, lands in the pool in a clatter, skids on his hip, springs up, arms raised.
Landed it!
units.name: KASPER

units.text: That wasn't a trick. That was a fall.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: A fall with style.
units.name: KASPER

units.text: Juniper drops her board, drags a foot, rolls the first few feet and then drops in, carving high up one wall, down, across the floor and up the opposite wall, trailing a hiss of wheels on concrete while Devonte whoops from the coping, Mireille tracks her with the phone, Anselma pulls her tape tight with her teeth, and Kasper dodges aside, hands on his head, laughing, until Juniper kicks the board up, catches it, and stands at the deep end with her chest heaving.
That's the line.
units.name: DEVONTE

units.text: It's my line.
units.name: JUNIPER

units.text: It's the line we all do.
units.name: DEVONTE

units.text: It's the line.
units.name: ANSELMA

units.text: Everyone looks at her.
She shrugs, stands, slides her board off the lip.
Wait for me.
units.name: ANSELMA

units.text: She rolls in.
The wheels sing.
The fairy lights flicker on, one bulb at a time, and the sky above goes from orange to violet to a deep, perfect blue.
